  • Maritime / Strait of Hormuz: Iran asserts right to control shipping after a vessel was hit near Oman. Tehran selectively allows passage for Russia, India, China; blocks others. Shipping remains at elevated risk.
  • Diplomacy & Pauses: U.S. President announced a second 10-day pause on U.S. strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 20:00 ET), citing an "Iranian government request." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan reported as mediator. Previous 5-day pause was violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr—pause credibility weak.
  • Nuclear / IAEA: IAEA access to Iranian nuclear sites reported granted under a new arrangement. Verification activity restarting amid Tehran limits.
  • Air Ops & Logistics: Multiple commercial flight scans note a small number of military flights (RCH461, C130, RCH801, CNV8405). Reports US considering repositioning Gulf bases westward, including to Israel. Earlier damage reported to key Fifth Fleet facilities in Bahrain.
  • Domestic / Other: IDF preparing for potential Gaza unrest along the Yellow Line. Israeli courts and domestic politics active but not altering operations.
  • 🟢 Good News: Reported local ceasefire in Lebanon; IAEA inspectors granted access to Iranian sites.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Northern Border (Lebanon): Daily Hezbollah activity. IAF struck Beit Yahun. Four IDF soldiers injured in a southern-Lebanon clash. Washington-hosted Lebanon–Israel talks extended; local ceasefires renewed intermittently.
  • Air campaign: Continued US/Israeli strikes on Iranian targets. Iran continues missile counterstrikes and naval/ballistic threats. Reports of degraded air defenses and civilian damage in some strikes.
  • Strait of Hormuz & shipping: Iran asserts control of Hormuz. Allows passage for Russia, India, China; restricts others. Recent ship strike near Oman raises shipping-risk profile.
  • IAEA / nuclear: Agreement reported to grant IAEA/UN inspectors access to some Iranian nuclear sites. IAEA pressing for verification amid Tehran’s limits.
  • Casualties & damage: Civilian injuries and infrastructure damage reported inside Iran and Lebanon. No confirmed major Israeli-city strikes in the last 48 hours.
  • Diplomacy: Talks fragile but active. US pause signals negotiation channel despite Iranian denials. Pakistan mediating. Lebanon talks extended in Washington.
  • 🟢 Good News: IAEA access deal reached; localized ceasefires in Lebanon; diplomatic mediation continues.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating
